name: Zoo Keeper 3D
summary: Zoo Keeper 3D is a 3DS puzzle game set in a zoo, where you match animals on a grid to clear them and keep the timer under control. Swap adjacent tiles to form matches of three or more, trigger drops and chain reactions, and complete missions across multiple modes. With 3D visuals, various gameplay options, and objectives that challenge both quick decision-making and efficient clearing, it delivers a fast, action-puzzle twist on classic tile matching.
